metadata.name: ManualReage
metadata.description: This API is used to add an Account Reage request in system.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MrPaymentLevel
request_fields.description: Signifies if Reage is to be applied at account or plan level Valid Values: Account/Plan Format: XXX Example: Account Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TypeOfManualReage
request_fields.description: Indicates if Reage is Full or Partial Valid Values: 0 - Full / 1 - Partial Format: Numeric Example: 0

request_fields.name: CycleDueMethod
request_fields.description: Indicates if method used to reage is Cycle Due Method and what is the delinquency level used to reage account 0 - Nothing Due 1 - Current Due 10 - No Payments 2 - Past Due 3 - 1 Cycle Past Due 4 - 2 Cycles Past Due 5 - 3 Cycles Past Due 6 - 4 Cycles Past Due 7 - 5 Cycles Past Due 8 - 6 Cycles Past Due 9 - 7 Cycles Past Due Valid Values: 0-10 Format: X Example: 0 Condition: Either TotalDueMethod or CycleDueMethod must be provided

request_fields.name: TotalDueMethod
request_fields.description: Indicates total amount due adjusted as reage Valid Values: 0-9 Format: Numeric Example: $150.00 Condition: Either TotalDueMethod or CycleDueMethod must be provided

request_fields.name: TotalDue
request_fields.description: Total Amount Due as on account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $150.99

request_fields.name: MrCurrentDue
request_fields.description: Amount current due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrOneCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount One Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrTwoCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Two Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrThreeCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Three Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrFourCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Four Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrFiveCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Five Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrSixCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Six Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrSevenCyclesPastDue
request_fields.description: Amount Seven Cycle past due on the account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: TotalPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Total Past due amount on the account  after adjustment in account reaging. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: MrTotalPastDue
request_fields.description: Total past due amount on the account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: TotalDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Total amount due on the account adjusted in account reaging Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.00

request_fields.name: CurrentDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Current amount due on the account after adjustment in account reaging Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.00

request_fields.name: PastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Past due amount on the account after adjustment in account reaging Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: OneCyclePastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: One Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: TwoCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Two Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: ThreeCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Three Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: FourCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Four Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: FiveCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Five Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: SixCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Six Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: SevenCyclesPastDueAdjusted
request_fields.description: Seven Cycle Past Due after adjusted. Ex: 0 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $100.50

request_fields.name: CustomerServiceReage
request_fields.description: Customer Service Re-age Selection will not increase the normal reage counter of account. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Example: 1

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
